A QUICK LITTLE INTRO

Good things flow.

One finger. A few colorful choices.

  1. 1

    Tap a chute

    The group at the front comes out together. The same color means the same move.

  2. 2

    Fill the matching cups

    Full cups make room for new ones. Peek at the upcoming colors and plan ahead.

  3. 3

    Leave a little breathing room

    Jellies without a matching cup wait in the tray. If it overflows, try a different order.
